summary: In September, we announced a global default policy for generally available GitHub Copilot features and supported client capabilities on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans. Starting today, we’re gradually rolling out enforcement of the policy through October 26, so it may take effect at different times for different enterprises and organizations.
takeaways: The policy applies to eligible settings on “Features & clients” and “MCP servers in Copilot”.
The post Global default for Copilot features generally available appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
You can review your setting under AI Controls → Copilot → Default policy for new features .
